Super Bots · layout review · painted build v38

Ten maps, ready for your notes

Every map as it plays right now, with the painted art in place, plus a coordinate grid so a note can point at an exact spot. One unit is one grid square; a bot is about one unit wide.

Say it in units

“Move the crane to x 18”, “make the perch 4 wide”, “raise the left ledge to y 8”, “pad at 25, 12 sending to 24, 6”.

Or name the part

Everything in a map’s part list has a name: “remove the stump”, “shorten the bridge by a third”, “move the right mid branch up 2”.

Then send it to Claude

Comment on the map’s picture, send the thread to Claude, and the change gets applied to the game and this page.

A picture comment tells me which map, but not where on the picture you clicked or drew. Put the position in the words: an x and y from the grid, or a part name with left or right.

Standard maps are 30 wide for 2 to 4 players, battle maps 46 to 50 wide for up to 8. Maps marked Loops have no side walls: leaving one edge brings you in on the other. Power-up spawn points are deliberately not shown.
